content.short: Orcfax is a decentralized Cardano oracle. Oracles publish data about the real world to blockchain smart contracts.
content.description: Orcfax implements the open-source Cardano Open Oracle Protocol (COOP) and provides Cardano developers with well-structured tools and schemas to consume trustworthy off-chain data in their smart contracts. Orcfax is a next-generation oracle platform that completely decentralizes data collection and validation in a permissionless manner while providing full audit logs for the flow of data through the platform.
content.meta: Find out about Orcfax (ORACLE) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
